import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

for target, source in re.findall(
    r'\b(TMP|[a-p])\s*<-\s*(TMP|[a-p]|\d+)\b', text
):
    values[target] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

names = [*'abcdefghijklmnop', 'TMP']
print('; '.join(f'{name} ?= {values[name]}' for name in names) + ';')
